selection: Highest aggregate moderate net gp/hour on development current-limit sensitivity, including no_trade; ties prefer no_trade. Freeze before opening holdout. All candidates reported once on holdout.
limits: Run unknown_limits_strict and current_limits_sensitivity. Current buy limits are never features.
availability: Inferred bucket start + 86400 + 300 seconds; fills only consume buckets starting after order submission plus latency.
ranking: CatBoost predicts per-unit net gp/hour; raw_spread and spread_volume rank literal after-tax gp spread and gp spread times side volume. No-change uses current instant-side prices.
tax: 2 percent floored per item, 5M cap, exactly 50 pays 1gp; no inferred item exemptions (conservative for exempt items).
catboost_target: Train-only 0.5/99.5 percentile clipped 24h net return; score predicted return times entry gp /24. Separate 10/50/90 MultiQuantile fit, same parameters. Errors on unclipped outcomes. Require 14 past observations, no survivor filter.
